content: Bicillin L-A, which is the injectable suspension form of penicillin G benzathine, is provided in packages containing 10 disposable syringes. The syringes are available in the following configurations: A 1 mL syringe containing 600,000 units of penicillin G benzathine. This syringe is equipped with a 21-gauge, thin-wall, 1-inch needle designed for pediatric use. The National Drug Code (NDC) for this product is 60793-700-10. A 2 mL syringe containing 1,200,000 units of penicillin G benzathine. This syringe is equipped with a 21-gauge, thin-wall, 1-1/2 inch needle. The NDC for this product is 60793-701-10. A 4 mL syringe containing 2,400,000 units of penicillin G benzathine. This syringe is equipped with an 18-gauge, 1-1/2 inch needle. The NDC for this product is 60793-702-10. The product should be stored in a refrigerator at a temperature range of 2° to 8°C (36° to 46°F). It must be protected from freezing.
